title: MWCC allocator capture and analysis
description: Capture stock MWCC PCode stages, register allocation and stack traces; analyze saved evidence offline.
status_message: Live runner v1: allocator captures use the stock hash-gated MWCC compiler under qemu-i386 with a synchronous gdb-multiarch driver.
limitations: Capture uses the stock compiler and does not require an instrumented build.
Capture is Linux sandbox-only; offline analysis can also run on macOS.
Qemu-emulated full traces can take minutes.
Allocator addresses are valid only for hash-gated GC/1.2.5 and GC/1.2.5n binaries.
Trace uses the current object function index when compiler names are absent, checks decoded names and object order, and reports the remaining symbol-order caveat.
Offline solver results require baseline replay agreement and real compile/checkdiff verification. Searches have fixed time and input limits.
Trace defaults to stages and graphs. Full event, creation and stack tracing is opt-in; omitted event classes are explicitly listed.
Analysis always saves a full workspace artifact and returns at most 8 KiB of result facts.

usage.agent_guidance: Use trace for source identity, PCode stages, GPR/FPR allocation, creation origins and stack evidence. Analyze saved files with provenance, explain, inverse, source-rank, stack or origins; validate baseline replay before using solver hypotheses.
